InternalError ? Typically a LOG_ERROR comes with a 5xx return code
Changed it to `BMCWEB_LOG_DEBUG`.
So if you get a D-Bus error you just leave off?
Yes, these properties are optional and we would only populates present properties.
WARNING typically is a 4xx error but I don't care as much here. An InternalError and a 5xx don't make sense here?
Changed it to `BMCWEB_LOG_DEBUG`.
Removed nullptr assignment. Since these properties are optional if any of the properties are not present we would not report an error and populate only present properties.

getAll doesn't make more sense than ~10 getProperty calls? E.g. 
https://github.com/openbmc/bmcweb/blob/9c75bf7a265a36d23fd92f979a3de227a9e11ff9/redfish-core/lib/thermal_metrics.hpp#L103

For each Metric Value, there is a separate DBus Object Path (Name of the Metric is part of the DBus Object Path) that hosts Interface `xyz.openbmc_project.Metric.Value`. Doing `GetAll` call is not possible in such case. Refer commit message of associated DBus sensor patch - https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/dbus-sensors/+/84132.
Is this nullptr needed?
Removed.
PDI needs to go first but seems reasonable to me
@gunnar@gmills.xyz can you help review the PDI - https://gerrit.openbmc.org/c/openbmc/phosphor-dbus-interfaces/+/84839?
Gunnar has reviewed the PDI patch.
Please don't pass json pointers as strings.  Pass json pointers using the json pointer object.  You convert below, so just pass it here. as a json_pointer
Please pass object paths using object_path.
Done
Please don't call getProperty for every metric.  Use getall when they exist on the same path to reduce the number of dbus calls.
For each Metric Value, there is a separate DBus Object Path that hosts Interface xyz.openbmc_project.Metric.Value. Doing GetAll call is not possible in such case.
Violation of COMMON_ERROR around dbus path creation.  Please use sdbusplus::message::object_path.
This needs rework to match updated PDIs (please review the PDIs).
Done.
